title: Science Tonight on Instagram: "The AI reporter finally revealed why they are drinking so much water!

classification.theory_summary: Argues against using AI-generated images in dream studies because it can contaminate/alter memory and shared-dream data; advocates doodling/writing dreams instead.
classification.skip_reason: No dream narrative, no described dream locations/events; discussion about AI and memory/dream documentation.

meta.author_theory: AI-generated images can introduce non-experiential visual data into memory and influence/warp later dream recall and perceived similarities in recurring/shared dream environments; recommends doodling/describing dreams instead of relying on AI recreations.

extraction.extraction_notes: Post contains no first-person dream report or describable in-dream scenes. Only general mentions of 'dreams' and 'mallworld' without concrete phenomenological details (no specific places, layouts, entities, events, or sensory qualities).
